signal: Filevine launched its LOIS Legal Operating Intelligence console in June 2026, after raising $400M to scale its AI legal platform

email.body1:
Brandon, saw Filevine launched the LOIS console this month, building on your $400M raise to scale AI for law firms.

A launch and a raise together usually mean more in-market firms than the team can cover before the message lands everywhere it should. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brandon, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Filevine needs to capitalize on the LOIS launch, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brandon, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brandon, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right after a launch and raise, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
